title: SessionIntent
description: What the operator is asking the agent to do for this casino visit. Produced by intent_parse_session via tool-use forcing on the parse_session_intent tool. The contract is the synthetic tool's input schema; the planner emits this once at session start.

flow.description: What kind of casino visit. play = bet money. navigate = walk to a specific room. audit = look around without betting. observe = watch one game without betting. report_only = produce a report off existing data.

kind.description: Game family. 'any' = no preference; resolver picks by popularity.

query.description: Free text from the operator. Resolver maps to slug; if zero hits, the search-bar branch types this literally.

slug.description: If the operator named a known catalog slug exactly. Skips fuzzy resolution.

max_loss_usd.description: Stop-loss for this visit. Will be silently capped to env MAX_LOSS_USD if higher.

terminal.description: Which condition ends the visit. First-of-many semantics: any matching budget bound triggers terminal.
